battle.name: 唐與突厥戰爭
battle.brief: 武德三年正月，秦王李世民在美良川、淺水原擊破劉武周部將宋金剛，迫其北走突厥，唐與東突厥的邊境戰爭自此開端；經渭水之盟，貞觀四年李靖夜襲定襄、追奔鐵山擒頗利可汗。卡面亞述長矛是公元前九世紀的短柄鐵刃，未隨軍到陰山，它代表的是長矛在亂軍中近身拒馬、刺穿密集隊形的那一層作用。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 唐與突厥戰爭是唐朝開國初期與漠北東突厥汗國之間的一場邊境戰爭，交戰重心在河套、陰山、定襄一線的草原與漠南山地，前後延續十年。唐方由太原起兵的關隴集團構成，兵源以關中、隴右、幷州為主，軍事指揮在武德年間歸秦王李世民的天策府與兵部尚書李靖等將領分掌，貞觀元年之後設天下兵馬行軍元帥總管，李靖為總管，張公謹、趙彥和、丘君行、蘇定方、史大奈、契苾何力等分任行軍副將；北伐序列以秦王府舊屬為突擊骨幹，並以內附的突厥騎兵充當向導與先鋒，漢地所出的糧秣、兵器與攻城器則由後方轉運。突厥一方是游牧部落聯盟，汗庭在陰山以北，頗利可汗以大汗身份統攝，諸部以俟斤、百長分領兵眾，騎兵為絕對主力，弓、馬與皮甲構成個人裝備，營帳隨水草遷徙，後方以牛羊群與乳酪肉乾供應，遇大戰則各部自行其是，並無可以集中全軍火力的指揮結構。戰爭裡還有第三種力量：北方劉武周、梁師都這些由突厥冊封為代理統治者的割據政權，620年劉武周覆亡之後，其眾散入漠南，成為突厥方面的補充兵源；西面的薛延陀與吐谷渾、鐵勒諸部或內附或叛離，方向並不一致，使汗國聯盟的凝聚力從一開始就不穩固。
countriesEn: The war between the Tang and the Turks was a frontier conflict fought by the early Tang dynasty against the Eastern Turkic Khaganate of the northern steppe, centred on the belt of grassland and hill country around Hetao, the Yinshan mountains and Dingxiang, and it ran for ten years. The Tang army was the Guanzhong, Longyou and Bingzhou bloc that had risen in Taiyuan; command during the Wude era was split between the Qin prince Li Shimin's Tian Ce fu and such ministers of war as Li Jing, and from the first year of Zhenguan a Grand Commander of the Imperial Army directed the northern campaigns, with Li Jing as commander-in-chief and Zhang Gongjin, Zhao Yanhe, Qiu Junxing, Su Dingfang, Shi Danai and Qibi Heli serving as deputy commanders. The striking force was built from veterans of the Qin prince's own staff, and Turkic cavalry who had already submitted to the Tang were employed as guides and as the vanguard, while grain, weapons and siege matériel came forward from the Chinese base by road and river. The Turkic side was a confederation of nomadic tribes whose khagan court lay north of the Yinshan range, ruled by Jieli Khan in his capacity of Great Khan, with each tribe led by its own qaghan or baizhang and cavalry forming the overwhelming majority of the army, while bow, horse and hide armour made up the individual soldier's kit. The encampments moved with the water and grass, the rear was fed by herds of cattle and sheep, cheese and dried meat, and in a great battle each tribe simply did as it pleased, since there was no structure able to concentrate the fire of the whole confederation. A third force also appears in the war: the northern client regimes of Liu Wuzhou and Liang Shidu, invested by the Turks as proxies for rule; when Liu Wuzhou's state collapsed in 620 his troops scattered south of the desert and became a reserve of manpower for the Turkic side. In the west, Xianyantuo and the Tuyuhun and the various Tiele tribes either submitted or broke away and did not all pull the same way, which left the confederation's cohesion shaky from the outset.
people: 唐太宗李世民是這場戰爭唯一的決策核心。他在天策府與秦王府的班底裡集結關隴精銳，620年正月以美良川、淺水原一連串追擊打垮劉武周部將宋金剛，迫得劉武周北走突厥，唐廷這才騰出手來專門對付汗國；626年八月他以單騎臨渭水的姿態與頗利可汗達成渭水之盟，為北伐換來整整十年的準備期。兵部尚書李靖是北伐主將：貞觀元年他率諸道兵十餘萬夜襲定襄，又以三千驍騎自馬邑出其不意直趨惡陽嶺，把汗庭逼到陰山；貞觀四年他再出朔方，在磧口擊潰頗利十餘萬騎，追奔至鐵山。左武候大將軍張公謹獻夜襲之策，以千餘精騎衣黑夜襲定襄；西州都督蘇定方在陰山以二百騎乘霧為先鋒，直趨牙帳。蕭瑀時任尚書右僕射，在渭水力諫不可出戰，房玄齡、杜如晦等秦王府幕僚在幕後籌劃應對，長孫無忌提出在渭南布疑兵之策，唐高祖李淵事後自悔渭水之議失策。突厥方面，頗利可汗自619年即汗位，其弟突利可汗後來內附唐朝；唐使唐儉、安修仁奉命赴突厥宣撫被扣留不回，頗利之叔康蘇密則奉命入朝請和，被留京不遣。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin, was the single decision-making core of the war. He gathered the elite of Guanzhong and Longyou in the staff of his Tian Ce fu and Qin princely office, and in the first month of the first year of Wude he broke Song Jin'gang, Liu Wuzhou's commander, in a series of pursuits at Meiliangchuan and on the shallow plain, driving Liu Wuzhou north to the Turks; only then did the Tang court find itself free to deal with the khaganate as a whole. In the eighth month of 626 he met Jieli Khan on the Wei River, alone at the water's edge, and the resulting agreement bought the northern campaign a full ten years of preparation. Li Jing, Minister of War, commanded that campaign: in the first year of Zhenguan he led more than a hundred thousand men of the various circuits in a night attack on Dingxiang, then took three thousand picked cavalry out of Mayi by a route the Turks did not expect and drove straight at Eyangling, pressing the khagan court up against the Yinshan mountains; in the fourth year of Zhenguan he marched out again from Shuofang, shattered more than a hundred thousand Turkic horsemen at Qikou and pursued them to Iron Mountain. The Left Warden of the Imperial Guard, Zhang Gongjin, proposed the night attack, taking a thousand picked horsemen in black to strike Dingxiang by surprise; Su Dingfang, then governor of Xizhou, led two hundred cavalry through the fog at Yinshan as the vanguard and drove straight for the tent of the khan. Xiao Yu, then Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, argued firmly at the Wei River that the army must not advance; Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui of the Qin prince's staff worked out the response behind the scenes; Changsun Wuji proposed deploying feigned troops on the south bank of the Wei; and the founding emperor Li Yuan later regretted the Wei River agreement as a mistaken policy. On the Turkic side, Jieli Khan had taken the khanate in 619, and his younger brother the Qaghan of the Turks, Tuli, eventually submitted to the Tang. Tang Jian and An Xiuren were sent to the Turks with the court’s overtures and were detained and never allowed home; Jieli's uncle Kang Sumi came to the Tang court to sue for peace and was kept in the capital and not permitted to return.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是公元前九世紀兩河流域的形制：短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃，亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綉在一起，用在攻城與野戰的密集步兵之中。它本身不可能出現在公元620年的陰山，這一點必須說清楚；它在本役的位置是兵種譜系上的源頭，而不是戰場上的實物。亞述式的短柄直刃鐵矛，代表的是以刃抵人、以桿隔騎的近身拒馬邏輯，而這正是唐軍槊隊與拒馬、突厥騎士面對密集矛陣時所真正要對付的那一層問題。唐軍在定襄與陰山真正裝備的是：環首直刃唐刀、雙刃陌刀、長桿馬槊與步槊（菱形矛刃綁在木桿上）、圓盾與拒馬、蹶張弩與早期床弩、角筋木複合步弓，以及數量不多的札甲與皮甲；銅機關弩與明光圓領甲在唐初尚不普及，騎兵多靠無鐙或單鐙的鞍與大量馬群維持速度，弓袋掛在腰側，長矛收在鞍橋之前。攻城方面有雲梯、撞車、臨衝車、井欄與投石飛石，糧秣靠黃河與運河轉運，牛車拉運、沿途牧場放牧，騎兵遠征時甚至以兵兼馬載糧。突厥一方的核心是角筋木複合短弓，箭鏃有骨、石、鐵三種，配短彎刀、長矛、皮甲與革盔，馬具低而輕，弓與箭壺隨身攜帶，遠征靠乳酪、風乾肉與乳製品充軍，馬群既是坐騎，也是食物與戰利品的來源；突厥幾乎不帶攻城器械，這正是唐軍得以用奇襲攻其牙帳的前提。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a form from the ninth century BC in Mesopotamia: a short haft, a long blade, an iron point, bound up by the Assyrians with bows and ironwork and used in dense infantry formations both in the field and before the walls. It could not possibly have been present on the Yinshan in AD 620, and that has to be said plainly; its place in this war is at the head of a lineage of weapons, not on the field. The Assyrian short-hafted, straight-edged iron spear embodies the logic of meeting a man with the blade and keeping a horse at a distance with the shaft, and that is precisely the layer of problem that Tang spear walls and caltrops, and Turkic horsemen, had to solve when they met one another. What the Tang army actually carried at Dingxiang and Yinshan was: ring-pommelled straight-edged Tang sabres, two-edged pole sabres, long-shafted horse and foot spears with rhombic heads bound to wooden shafts, round shields and caltrops, spring-loaded and early bed crossbows, composite bows of horn, sinew and wood, and a limited amount of lamellar and hide armour; the bronze-triggered crossbow and the plain bright round-necked armour of the mid-Tang were not yet in general use. Their cavalry kept speed on saddles with a single stirrup or none at all and on large herds, with the bow case slung at the waist and the lance stowed in front of the saddle bow. For siege work they had scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers, wall galleries and stone-throwing engines, while grain came by the Yellow River and the canals, hauled in ox-carts and grazed on pastures along the way, and cavalry on the march even carried their rations on the horses they rode. The core of the Turkic kit was the short composite bow of horn, sinew and wood, with bone, stone and iron arrowheads, a short curved knife, a lance, hide armour and leather caps, a low and light saddle, and bow and quiver carried on the person; on campaign they lived on cheese, dried meat and dairy, and their herds of horses were at once their mounts, their food and the object of war. The Turks brought almost no siege engines with them, and that is precisely the precondition that allowed the Tang to strike at the khan's tent by surprise.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸，是唐軍用快速騎兵、夜襲與斷糧的組合，去撬動以騎兵為主卻缺乏統一指揮的汗國聯盟。620年的開端仍屬追擊戰：李世民率騎兵自幷州北進，在美良川擊潰宋金剛之後連追至雀鼠谷，一日八戰皆破，俘斬數萬，接著攻取介休，迫降尉遲敬德，四月逼得劉武周北走突厥，北方代理人政權就此崩潰，衝突正式轉入草原。草原上的突厥騎兵有自己的辦法：不與唐軍步陣硬拼，靠騎射迂迴逼近後放箭再退，或以沙塵遮蔽接近，遇到唐軍主力就散歸草場，各部自行其是；汗國的名義因此始終無法把各部綁成一個整體。也正因如此，唐廷的戰術選擇是側擊而非正攻：貞觀元年六月，張公謹建議以千餘精騎衣黑夜襲定襄，李靖率諸道兵十餘萬趨之，頗利夜遁；李靖復以三千驍騎自馬邑出其不意直趨惡陽嶺，迫其北走依陰山；貞觀四年正月，李靖引兵至磧口，遇頗利十餘萬騎，蘇定方以二百騎乘霧為先鋒直趨牙帳，唐軍破其萬餘帳，追奔至鐵山。追擊至此為止，因為糧草已盡而塞外苦寒，李靖詔令班師，並沒有追入漠北。渭水之役則是另一種戰術：以秦王府的疑兵陣與李世民單騎臨水的姿態，製造大軍在側的印象，再用金帛換取渭水為界，換來十年不受干擾的整軍期。
tacticsEn: The main tactical axis of this war was the Tang combination of fast cavalry, night attacks and cutting the enemy's supplies, used to prise apart a confederation whose strength lay in horsemen but whose command was fragmented. The opening in 620 was still a pursuit: Li Shimin drove north from Bingzhou with cavalry, and after breaking Song Jin'gang at Meiliangchuan he pursued him as far as the Sparrow Rat Valley, fighting eight engagements in a single day and winning them all, taking and killing tens of thousands, then took Jiehu and forced the surrender of Yuchi Jingde, and in the fourth month drove Liu Wuzhou north to the Turks; the northern client regime collapsed and the conflict moved properly out onto the steppe. Turkic horsemen had their own way of doing business: they did not strike head-on against a Tang foot formation, but rode around and shot from range, then withdrew, or used dust to close the distance, and when they met the main body of the Tang army they simply dispersed back to their pastures, each tribe doing as it liked. The khagan's name could therefore never bind the tribes into a single whole. For exactly that reason the Tang chose to strike the flank rather than the front. In the sixth month of the first year of Zhenguan, Zhang Gongjin proposed that a thousand picked horsemen in black attack Dingxiang by night, and Li Jing moved on it with more than a hundred thousand men of the circuits; Jieli fled by night. Li Jing then took three thousand picked cavalry out of Mayi by an unexpected route and drove straight for Eyangling, forcing the Turks north against the Yinshan range. In the first month of the fourth year of Zhenguan Li Jing brought his army to Qikou, where he found more than a hundred thousand Turkic horsemen; Su Dingfang led two hundred cavalry through the fog as the vanguard and struck the khan's tent, the Tang army broke some ten thousand tents, and the pursuit ran to Iron Mountain. There it stopped, for the grain had run out and the cold beyond the wall was bitter; Li Jing received the order to return, and the pursuit was never carried into the northern desert. The engagement on the Wei River was a different kind of warfare: the feigned deployment of the Qin prince's troops and the sight of Li Shimin alone at the water's edge created the impression of a great army at hand, and silver and silk were then traded for a line fixed at the Wei, which bought ten years of unmolested training and refitting.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。突厥方面的兵力只有概數：舊唐書與新唐書都記東突厥控弦百餘萬，這是史官的誇大約數，實際能戰之眾當以數十萬計，先後內附唐廷者亦達數十萬之眾。626年八月渭水之際，頗利可汗自將騎兵十餘萬進逼渭水北岸。627年六月定襄之役，李靖等率諸道步騎十餘萬往擊，夜襲所用的是千餘精騎；其後李靖率驍騎三千自馬邑直趨惡陽嶺。630年正月陰山之役最為詳盡：唐軍至磧口，遇上頗利遣將率領的十餘萬騎，蘇定方以二百騎乘霧為先鋒破之，唐軍破突厥萬餘帳，俘男女十餘萬口，獲牛羊數十萬頭，殺傷數萬，頗利本人隨即在鐵山被張寶相所擒，送抵京師。距離上，頗利牙帳在定襄西北，離長安有數千里之遙，一說約二千餘里，因此漢文記載常以深入其境來形容這次奔襲。唐軍自身的確切損失史無記載，只能說長途奔襲與塞外極寒造成大量消耗，戰馬與芻秣的損耗尤重。時間上，從620年劉武周覆亡、衝突轉入草原，到630年正月擒汗，跨度約十年，扣掉渭水之約後的整軍期，實戰集中在貞觀元年至四年之間。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows. Turkic strength is known only in round numbers: both the Old and the New Tang histories record the Eastern Turks as having more than a million men under bow-strings, a figure of deliberate exaggeration, and the troops actually fit for war must be put at a few hundred thousand, of whom several hundred thousand submitted to the Tang over the years. In the eighth month of 626, at the Wei River, Jieli Khan himself led more than a hundred thousand horsemen down to the north bank. In the sixth month of 627, at Dingxiang, Li Jing and his colleagues marched out with more than a hundred thousand foot and horse of the circuits, and the night attack was carried out with a thousand picked riders; after that Li Jing took three thousand picked cavalry out of Mayi and drove at Eyangling. The campaign of the first month of 630 is the best documented of all: the Tang army reached Qikou and found more than a hundred thousand Turkic horsemen under a commander sent by Jieli; Su Dingfang broke them with two hundred cavalry riding in the fog as the vanguard, the Tang destroyed some ten thousand tents, took more than a hundred thousand men and women captive, captured tens of thousands of head of cattle and sheep, and killed or wounded tens of thousands; Jieli himself was taken shortly afterwards at Iron Mountain by Zhang Baoxiang and brought to the capital. As for distance, the khan's tent lay north-west of Dingxiang, some thousands of li from Chang'an, one reckoning puts it at rather more than two thousand li, which is why the Chinese accounts describe the ride as reaching deep into the enemy's country. The Tang's own losses are not recorded in figures; one can only say that a long ride across frozen country and the bitter cold beyond the wall consumed a great deal, above all in horses and fodder. In time, the span from the collapse of Liu Wuzhou in 620, which pushed the conflict out onto the steppe, to the capture of the khan in the first month of 630, is about ten years, and once the decade of refitting after the Wei River agreement is subtracted, the actual fighting falls between the first and fourth years of Zhenguan.
cause: 打起來的根子有兩條，一條在外部，一條在內部。外部是隋末北方崩解留下的爛帳：突厥以來就以冊封行軍元帥的方式插手中原，劉武周、竇建德、薛舉、梁師都先後接受突厥的官號與兵援，倚其騎兵就能在雁門、井陘、河套打開缺口。李世民在關中起兵的時候，北方有劉武周與梁師都兩個突厥代理人，運河的漕運線與絲路北段都暴露在騎兵來去之下；不先解決這兩處，唐朝連關中的安全都沒有保證。620年正月美良川、淺水原的追擊打掉了劉武周的主力，四月劉武周與宋金剛北走突厥，唐軍在追擊中第一次直接面對漠北騎兵，這場邊境戰爭由此開端。內部的線索在突厥本身：始畢可汗619年死後，頗利可汗接位，但汗國聯盟內有弟兄之爭、薛延陀脫離、鐵勒反叛，草原的整合能力遠不如帳面人口；劉武周一倒，突厥失去最有效的南進代理人，遂改為親自用兵，衝突由代理戰升級為唐與汗國之間的直接戰爭。而唐廷在渭水之約換來的十年，正好用來練騎兵、修倉儲、籌草料，於是有了貞觀元年之後那幾場千里奇襲。
causeEn: There were two roots to the war, one outside and one inside. The outer one was the wreckage left by the collapse of the northern empire of Sui: for years the Turks had meddled in the Central Plain by investing client rulers with the title of Commander-in-Chief, and Liu Wuzhou, Dou Jiande, Xue Ju and Liang Shidu in turn accepted Turkic titles and Turkic troops, and it was the Turkic horse that opened breaches at Yanmen, Jingxing and Hetao. When Li Shimin raised his banner in Guanzhong there stood two Turkic proxies in the north, Liu Wuzhou and Liang Shidu, and the canal transport lines and the northern stretch of the silk road lay open to the comings and goings of horsemen; until those two were settled, even the security of Guanzhong was not assured. The pursuit at Meiliangchuan and on the shallow plain in the first month of 620 destroyed the main body of Liu Wuzhou's force, and in the fourth month Liu Wuzhou and Song Jin'gang fled north to the Turks, so that the Tang army, still pursuing, met steppe horsemen face to face for the first time and this frontier war opened. The inner line lay in the Turkic confederation itself: after Shibi Khan died in 619 Jieli Khan succeeded him, but the alliance seethed with quarrels between brothers, with Xianyantuo's departure and with Tiele revolts, and the steppe's capacity to hold itself together was far below its nominal numbers. With Liu Wuzhou's fall the Turks lost their most effective agent for advancing south, so they took to the field themselves, and the conflict rose from a war fought by proxies into a direct war between the Tang and the khaganate. The ten years bought by the agreement on the Wei River served the Tang court exactly as it needed: training cavalry, building depots, gathering fodder, so that the long night rides of the first year of Zhenguan onward became possible.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是草原權力結構的一次重排，而唐廷收穫的是一個能經營的邊疆。頗利可汗被擒後，東突厥汗國在名義上解體，其眾或降或散：唐廷在雲中置單于都護府，下設渾都督府、狼煙都督府等，以都督與州縣的形式羈縻編制，漠南草原第一次被正式划入唐的行政與軍事框架；內附的突厥貴族多授官封爵，阿史那社爾、契苾何力這類人成了唐的將領，草原騎兵也開始進入唐軍序列，成為骨幹。絲路北段與河套的交通線隨之打通，馬匹、皮革與畜牧品的交換把中原與漠南綁在一起，長安的馬政第一次有了穩定來源。這種格局並不等於草原從此安寧：汗國留下的權力真空很快由薛延陀與回紇接手，唐廷只能以冊封、質子、聯姻與天可汗的虛名去維持宗主地位，回紇後來協助唐平定安史之亂，也由此開啟唐代與草原關係的新一輪起伏。制度上，渭水之約與擒汗之間那十年，把唐的邊防思路從守推移到以夷制夷，而與之配套的，是後來開元年間修築的陰山道長城，把漠南的界線固定成一道人造的線。對東亞格局而言，唐朝自此自居天朝，北方的邊患由壓力源變成資源地，這是唐代國際秩序的底色之一。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was a rearrangement of power in the steppe, and what the Tang court gained was a frontier it could actually govern. Once Jieli Khan was in chains the Eastern Turkic khaganate dissolved in name, and its people either submitted or scattered: the court established the office of the Protector General of the Single Khan at Yunzhong and set up such bodies as the Duhu Dudu Fu for the Hun and the Langyan Dudu Fu for the qaghan's clans, administering the new territory through commanderies and prefectures in the form of a loose harness. For the first time the grasslands south of the desert were formally drawn into the Tang administrative and military framework; Turkic nobles who submitted were granted offices and titles, men such as Ashina She'er and Qibi Heli became Tang generals, and steppe cavalry began to enter the Tang order of battle as its backbone. The northern stretch of the silk road and the roads of Hetao were opened, and the exchange of horses, hides and livestock products bound the Central Plain to the southern steppe, giving the capital's remount policy a steady source for the first time. This arrangement did not mean that the steppe was henceforth at peace: the vacuum left by the khaganate was quickly taken over by Xianyantuo and then by the Uyghur, and the Tang court could hold its overlordship only through investiture, hostages, marriage and the empty title of Heavenly Khan; the Uyghur would later help the Tang put down the An Lushan rebellion, and that too opened a new round of ups and downs in Tang relations with the steppe. Institutionally, the decade between the agreement on the Wei River and the capture of the khan shifted the Tang frontier thinking from mere defence towards using the barbarians to control the barbarians, and the matching work was the Yinshan road wall built in the Kaiyuan era, which fixed the southern-steppe frontier as an artificial line. For the East Asian order, the Tang had henceforth taken up the position of the Celestial Dynasty, and the northern threat changed from a source of pressure into a source of resources, one of the ground colours of the Tang international system.
result: 到了貞觀四年，局面的收束相當乾淨：唐軍在磧口打垮頗利十餘萬騎，頗利被張寶相擒獲送京，東突厥汗國就此瓦解，諸部有的受編於單于都護府，有的散入漠北與西域，唐朝取得陰山以北至大漠的一大片控制權。但追擊並沒有走完：李靖以糧草已盡、塞外苦寒為由停止追擊，詔令班師，汗國殘部與散騎仍在漠北活動，內訌數年之後才被回紇取代，唐代邊疆此後面對的是一個又一個新的草原政權，而不是一個統一的對手。對唐廷本身，這一輪戰爭解除了北方的直接威脅，漕運與絲路北段得以恢復，府兵與騎兵的戰備經過十年整頓後又用在了另一個方向，即645年唐太宗東征高句麗；對草原，這是汗國時代的終結與部族聯盟時代的開端，遊牧政治從此以更小、更碎的單位運作，而唐充當了仲裁者與宗主。回頭看兵器這條線也一樣清楚：亞述長矛那種短柄直刃鐵矛早已不屬於620年的裝備序列，唐軍真正握在手上的是長桿馬槊、陌刀、唐刀與拒馬，突厥靠的是複合短弓與騎射；這場戰爭本身說明的是同一件事，決定草原戰爭勝負的並不只在某一件兵器的形制，而在於能不能把騎兵的速度、箭矢的消耗與草場的距離變成可以計算的東西。
resultEn: By the fourth year of Zhenguan the business was closed with some sharpness: the Tang army broke more than a hundred thousand Turkic horsemen at Qikou, Jieli was taken by Zhang Baoxiang and brought to the capital, the Eastern Turkic khaganate dissolved, some of its tribes were enrolled under the Protector General of the Single Khan while others scattered into the northern desert and the western regions, and the Tang gained control of a broad belt from north of the Yinshan range to the great desert. The pursuit, however, was not carried to the end: Li Jing halted it on the grounds that the grain had run out and the cold beyond the wall was bitter, and the order came to break off, so that the remnants of the khaganate and the scattered horsemen still moved about in the northern desert and were not replaced by the Uyghur until several years of internal strife had run their course. From then on the Tang frontier faced one new steppe power after another rather than a single unified enemy. For the Tang court itself the war lifted the direct pressure from the north, restored the canal transport and the northern silk road, and the training of the fubing and the cavalry, after ten years of refitting, was turned to another direction altogether, namely Li Shimin's eastern expedition against Goguryeo in 645. For the steppe it was the end of the age of the khaganate and the opening of the age of tribal leagues: steppe politics henceforth worked through smaller and more fragmented units, while the Tang stood as arbiter and overlord. The line of weapons shows the same thing. The short-hafted, straight-edged Assyrian spear had long since dropped out of any equipment list for the year 620; what the Tang soldiers actually held were long-shafted horse lances, pole sabres, Tang sabres and caltrops, and what the Turks relied on was the composite short bow and mounted archery. The war itself makes the same point that the kit does: what decided the outcome of a steppe war was not the shape of any one weapon, but whether the speed of cavalry, the consumption of arrows and the distances across pasture could be turned into quantities a commander could calculate.
